sources.name: OpenStreetMap Overpass power metadata
sources.note: Transformer, substation, generator and plant metadata drives mapped-appearance dots; timestamps are OSM history, not commissioning dates

electricityMethod.rendering: Power lines and substations use load percentage and headroom status, similar to GRID heatmap/viability scoring.
electricityMethod.caveat: Belfast load is a replay proxy; asset locations come from OSM power tags, and Overpass timestamps show when assets became visible in OSM, not confirmed commissioning dates.
